company.name: Pepper
company.shortDescription: Pepper provides an AI-powered eCommerce platform for food distributors and suppliers to manage customer engagement and order workflows.
company.description: Pepper provides an AI-powered sales platform designed for food distributors and suppliers to manage customer engagement and order workflows. The platform centralizes product catalogs, pricing, promotions, and inventory data, allowing sales representatives and customers to place and manage orders digitally. Pepper integrates with existing ERP and accounting systems to synchronize order processing, invoicing, and reporting functions. Its tools support mobile sales, real-time communication, and data tracking to streamline interactions between distributors and their buyers. The system also includes analytics features that help teams monitor purchasing patterns, manage accounts, and coordinate sales activities across channels.
